title: Shadownet Credential JWT payload
description: Payload of a shadownet-cred+jwt. Defined in rfcs/0001-shadownet.md §6.1. The JWS header MUST be { alg: 'EdDSA', typ: 'shadownet-cred+jwt' } and is not covered by this schema. Identifiers (iss, sub, org) accept either domains, Shadownames, or multibase Ed25519 public keys per the addressing mode of the issuer / subject / organization.

iss.description: Issuer identifier — a domain (Shadowname-mode issuer) or a multibase Ed25519 public key (direct-mode keyed issuer / Hub). Must be authorized to issue for `org` per §6.6.

sub.description: The Shadow being attested — either a canonical Shadowname (local@provider) or a multibase Ed25519 public key (direct-mode Shadow).

kind.description: Attestation kind. v0.2 defines exactly one.

org.description: Organization the Shadow is affiliated with — a domain or a multibase Ed25519 public key (keyed Hub).

exp.description: Expiry, Unix seconds. Conformance suite enforces exp - iat ≤ 2592000 (30 days) for `org_affiliation` per §6.3.

epoch.description: Revocation list epoch identifier. For domain issuers, the status list is fetched from https://<iss>/.well-known/shadownet/status/<epoch>. For keyed issuers, the AgentCard's `shadownet:statusListBase` field gives the URL base.

idx.description: Bit index in the status list bitstring.
